versions.changelog: Add structure-first anti-generic review gates, honest-content constraints, and stronger visual review checks.
Refactor skill package for cleaner agent-first consumption; split long manual into focused references and keep MCP workflow guidance concise.
Clean up native-app transfer guidance rendering while preserving the Stitch-to-app workflow improvements.
Improve Stitch-to-app transfer with route selection, screenshot-first acceptance, native-app implementation loop, and real viewport parity checks.

Major Stitch→implementation reliability upgrade (cumulative since 1.4.2).

  - Adds MCP-first startup handshake + hard approval gates.
  - Clarifies MCP vs browser-only boundaries and strengthens failure recovery for long-running generations.
  - Introduces artifact-first transfer (PRD + reference + approved screen family) with:
    - required transfer contract
    - per-screen integration checklist
    - explicit parity gates (visual + interaction/state + multi-target)
    - drift logs (missing/mismatched/intentional) for scoped repair
  - Adds a non-multimodal text-first path (DESIGN.md + approved exports).
  - Adds practical export-selection guidance plus a per-screen Fidelity Pack:
    - reference screenshots
    - export snapshot
    - token map + structure map
  - Adds token extraction rules from exported code and a first translation pass recipe (UI primitives first) to avoid “generic”
  implementations.
  - Adds a context-menu→MCP mapping and an explicit rule to request browser export/download when MCP cannot snapshot zip/assets.
Expand DESIGN.md semantics and tighten the Stitch operating model around prompt rewriting, operation choice, and pass reporting.
Refine DESIGN.md guidance for Stitch and tighten wording to avoid external repo references.

v1.4.0: Competitor review additions — component isolation, hub-first multi-screen rule, feature coverage matrix, style keyword table, prompt structure template, TCP drop awareness, HTTP error table, sketch-to-design workflow, 6 new anti-patterns.

v1.3.0: Major expansion with creative direction framework, design system guidance, model selection, prompt patterns, variants, export strategy, and autonomous agent pipeline. From 8 YouTube video sources.
Add greenfield-app guidance: use accepted Stitch exports as translation seeds instead of rebuilding from screenshots.
Improve public bundle structure, readability, and supporting references.
